name: Hospitaler
summary: A charitable healer who trades frequent smites and Aura of Justice for independent channeling and a restorative aura.

featureOverrides.summary: Smite evil once per day, gaining one additional daily use at 7th level and every 6 levels thereafter.
featureOverrides.scaling: additional use at 7th and every 6 levels

features.name: Hospitaler Channel Energy
features.summary: Channel positive energy as a Cleric of Paladin level –3 without expending lay on hands.

features.name: Aura of Healing
features.summary: Spend one channel use to create a 30-foot aura for Paladin-level rounds that stabilizes, prevents bleed, heals each ally once, and grants one extra affliction save.
